Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤔. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his voice firm but gentle 💊.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 🤝."

JACK:
"I don't want it. I don't need it. I'm fine." 🙅‍♂️

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you know as well as I do that you're not fine. You're sick, and this medication is the only thing that can help you 🤕."

JACK:
"I don't need your help. I can take care of myself." 💪

DR. SMITH:
"Fine, then. If you won't take it, I'll take it for you." 💊

Dr. Smith forces the pills into Jack's mouth, and Jack swallows, his eyes flashing with anger 🔥. Dr. Smith hands him a glass of water, and Jack drinks, his expression unchanging 🤐.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring at the clock on his wall, his eyes fixed on the ticking hands ⏰. He looks up, and suddenly, Jack is standing in front of him, a mischievous grin spreading across his face 😏.

JACK:
"You know, Doc, I've been thinking. Maybe you're the one who's been pretending to be me all along." 🤔

DR. SMITH:
"What are you talking about?" 😕

JACK:
"I'm talking about the fact that you're the one who's been taking my medication, not me. You're the one who's been pretending to be the doctor." 🤯

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock, and he looks down at his hands, realizing the truth 💥. He looks up at Jack, and for a moment, they just stare at each other, the only sound the ticking of the clock ⏰.

JACK:
"You see, Doc, I've been watching you. I've been watching you take my medication, and I've been watching you pretend to be me. And I have to say, you're not very good at it." 😂

Dr. Smith's face contorts in a mixture of fear and realization, and he slumps back in his chair, defeated 😔. Jack turns and walks away, disappearing into thin air 🔮.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
